sources.title: Evaluating Gesture Generation in a Large-scale Open Challenge: The GENEA Challenge 2022
sources.verification: Author-hosted 28-page PDF inspected; DOI landing page later returned 403. OpenAlex independently matched title and DOI.
sources.supports: Evaluate human-likeness separately from speech appropriateness; gestures have multiple plausible realizations; conventional automatic scores do not establish perceived quality.
sources.project_inference: Keep native motion quality checks separate from clause intent scoring. Author acceptable action sets and evaluate all-none collapse explicitly.
sources.limits: Does not prescribe this project's label sets, necessity taxonomy, loss weights or Live2D thresholds; these are our experimental design.

sources.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
sources.verification: Official proceedings metadata and abstract verified; OpenAlex found the corresponding arXiv record.
sources.supports: Classifier confidence may be miscalibrated; temperature scaling can improve confidence calibration in the studied classification settings.
sources.project_inference: Fit a small temperature grid on separate calibration stories and evaluate NLL/Brier on development stories; never use confidence as body strength.
sources.limits: Temperature scaling does not correct the class ranking and gives no guarantee for unseen dialogue domains.

sources.title: Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks
sources.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 30
sources.verification: Official proceedings metadata and abstract verified.
sources.supports: A reject option trades prediction coverage against error risk.
sources.project_inference: Report missed required gestures alongside forbidden activations rather than optimizing only a low false-trigger rate.
sources.limits: Its image-classification risk guarantees do not transfer to this small, clustered, assistant-labeled gesture study.

excluded_from_evidence: Search-only papers not inspected in primary sources
